summary.notes: CONFIRMED joinable subgroup across 14 broken-access-control members: the Jobs, Backups, and StorageProviders REST controllers all gate state-changing routes on current_user_can('backwpup') at src/Jobs/API/Rest.php:87, src/Backups/API/Rest.php:81, and src/StorageProviders/API/Rest.php:138. The role installer grants that broad capability to lower-privilege custom roles while withholding narrower edit/start/settings rights at inc/class-install.php:147, inc/class-install.php:149, inc/class-install.php:150, inc/class-install.php:156, inc/class-install.php:166, inc/class-install.php:168, inc/class-install.php:175. UNCERTAIN members remain: process_bulk_actions still lacks end-to-end proof, and getblock shares the same trust boundary but is a separate disclosure sink family.

suggested_actions.reason: These routes form one stronger cross-bundle hypothesis: non-read REST actions in Jobs, Backups, and StorageProviders are all guarded only by has_permission() -> current_user_can('backwpup') at src/Jobs/API/Rest.php:87, src/Backups/API/Rest.php:81, and src/StorageProviders/API/Rest.php:138, while inc/class-install.php assigns backwpup=true to roles that still lack narrower edit/start/settings capabilities.

The route shares the same broad backwpup guard and reaches a deletion sink at src/Backups/API/Rest.php:420, but the compact evidence pack does not yet prove that a role lacking delete rights can supply an accepted backups[].dataset.data-url object end to end.

getblock uses the same broad current_user_can('backwpup') gate at src/Frontend/API/Rest.php:66 and can reach decrypted FTP credentials at parts/sidebar/storage-FTP.php:178, but its sink is credential disclosure through helper-rendered HTML rather than the state-changing mutation pattern that unifies the other members.

proposed_links.reason: All nine job-management endpoints are registered under the Jobs REST controller with permission_callback => has_permission(), and that callback collapses to current_user_can('backwpup') at src/Jobs/API/Rest.php:87 even though the role installer distinguishes backwpup from backwpup_jobs_edit in inc/class-install.php:147, inc/class-install.php:149, inc/class-install.php:166, and inc/class-install.php:168.

These cross-bundle routes perform job execution or storage/auth mutation but still rely on the same broad backwpup capability in src/Backups/API/Rest.php:81 and src/StorageProviders/API/Rest.php:138; the installer shows a role with backwpup=true but backwpup_jobs_start=false and backwpup_settings=false at inc/class-install.php:147, inc/class-install.php:150, and inc/class-install.php:156.

The storage-credential disclosure and storage-auth mutation endpoints sit behind the same broad current_user_can('backwpup') guard in src/Frontend/API/Rest.php:66 and src/StorageProviders/API/Rest.php:138, but only the trust boundary is shared; the evidence does not justify merging disclosure and mutation into one finding.

objections.reason: The optional evidence confirms the same broad route guard, but the helper-mediated data flow from getblock() into credential-bearing templates is not fully validated in the inspected code set, so folding it into the BAC cluster would overstate the common chain.

The pack shows query-string parsing at src/Backups/API/Rest.php:401 and deletion at src/Backups/API/Rest.php:420, but it does not yet show a reproducible low-privileged path to a valid backup descriptor or prove that the generic backwpup gate bypasses the intended delete-specific control in practice.

open_questions.question: Does the helper path behind getblock() let caller-controlled block_data.job_id reach the FTP template without any additional capability filtering or template allowlist beyond block_name/block_type?
open_questions.why_it_matters: That decides whether the disclosure is just adjacent to the BAC cluster or is another instance of the same capability-collapse pattern.

open_questions.question: Can a user who has backwpup=true but lacks backwpup_backups_delete obtain or forge a backups[].dataset.data-url value that process_bulk_actions() will accept?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Without that, the deletion member stays UNCERTAIN even though the route-level guard matches the broader cluster.

open_questions.question: Which feature-specific capability is intended for storage-provider configuration and cloud-auth changes: backwpup_settings, backwpup_jobs_edit, or only backwpup?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The cluster already shows a shared broad guard, but identifying the intended narrower capability would sharpen the final report language and severity rationale.

missing_evidence.evidence_needed: A compact trace from the helper adapter into the storage-FTP template showing that attacker-controlled block_data.job_id becomes the template's $job_id without extra authorization checks.
missing_evidence.reason: The current optional snippets confirm the route and the decrypted credential sink, but not the full source-to-sink path.

missing_evidence.evidence_needed: A role-based trace or reproducible request showing that a user with backwpup=true but without backup-delete rights can submit an accepted backup descriptor to process_bulk_actions().
missing_evidence.reason: That is the missing proof needed to upgrade the member from REVIEW to the cluster's CONFIRMED shared-guard hypothesis.

missing_evidence.evidence_needed: A compact code anchor or product rule showing the intended feature-level capability for storage-provider and cloud-auth operations.
missing_evidence.reason: The shared trust boundary is already visible, but the exact intended privilege level for these routes is still inferred rather than directly evidenced.

expansion_attempts.reason: Used the optional-file budget to test whether getblock-secret-disclosure shares the same trust boundary as the BAC members.
expansion_attempts.result: Confirmed the route also uses current_user_can('backwpup') at src/Frontend/API/Rest.php:66 and that the FTP template decrypts stored credentials at parts/sidebar/storage-FTP.php:178, but the inspected optional set did not fully prove the helper-mediated source-to-sink path, so the finding stays separate.

expansion_attempts.reason: Used the one out-of-band file to verify whether the generic backwpup capability is broader than the feature-specific capabilities implicated by the cluster.
expansion_attempts.result: Confirmed the role model is broader: backwpup_check and backwpup_helper receive backwpup=true at inc/class-install.php:147 and inc/class-install.php:166 while narrower rights such as backwpup_jobs_edit, backwpup_jobs_start, and backwpup_settings remain false on those roles at inc/class-install.php:149, inc/class-install.php:150, inc/class-install.php:156, inc/class-install.php:168, and inc/class-install.php:175.
